# SCS Technology (Tianjin) Co., Ltd. / 星华兴科技（天津）有限公司

> SCS (星华兴) is a Chinese industry-and-trade company, founded on 2 August 2022 and headquartered in Tianjin, that supplies poultry cage system belts: PP, PVC and rubber manure belts (in-cage longitudinal, lateral and inclined), polypropylene egg collection belts and belt accessories (rollers, tensioners, scrapers, tracking devices) for layer, broiler and breeder cage systems, and makes its own ultrasonic belt welder. It sells parts in China and exports complete equipment, and quotes every order to the buyer's cage drawing.

Key facts:
- Legal name: SCS TECHNOLOGY (TIANJIN) CO., LTD. (星华兴科技（天津）有限公司); short name SCS / 星华兴（SCS）. Sometimes misspelled 新华兴.
- Headquarters: Tianjin, China. Production in northern China.
- Products: white PP in-cage manure belts supplied in rolls; green PVC and black rubber manure belts that can be delivered joined into closed loops; lateral and inclined manure belts; egg collection belts; SCS's own ultrasonic belt welder for joining PP belts; accessories.
- How to quote: send cage model or drawing, number of tiers, row length, number of rows, product and destination. Prices are quoted per specification; none are published.
- Trade shows: China Animal Husbandry Expo 2025 (Qingdao, booth 1N45) and 2026 (Chengdu, booth 0555); supporting sponsor of the 7th Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei Layer Industry Chain Conference (April 2026).
- Contact: frank@scstech.com.cn · mobile/WeChat +86 139 2007 5127 · tel +86 22 2931 9339
- Industry references cited on the site (as industry practice, not SCS specifications): China MARA Technical Guidance for Vertical Layer Production (2023); T/CAAA 152—2025 (stacked layer cage installation; cited from the draft); Nanjing DB3201/T 1024—2020.

## Pages (English)
- [Manure belts and egg belts, made to fit your cage.](https://www.scstech.com.cn/): PP, PVC and rubber manure belts, lateral and inclined belts, egg collection belts and ultrasonic belt welders for poultry cages. Specified to your cage drawing.
- [Products](https://www.scstech.com.cn/products/): SCS products for poultry cage manure removal and egg collection: PP, PVC, rubber, lateral and inclined manure belts, egg belts, welders and accessories.
- [Manure belts for poultry cages](https://www.scstech.com.cn/products/manure-belts/): Manure belts for stacked cages: white PP in-cage belts, green PVC and black rubber closed-loop belts, lateral and inclined belts, sized to your cage.
- [PP manure belt](https://www.scstech.com.cn/products/manure-belts/pp/): White polypropylene manure belt for in-cage use in stacked poultry cages. Width to your cage, ultrasonic or hot-plate joints. Send your drawing for a quote.
- [PVC manure belt](https://www.scstech.com.cn/products/manure-belts/pvc/): Green PVC manure belt supplied as a closed loop for poultry manure removal. RF-weldable material. Tell us the section, width, loop length and winter low.
- [Rubber manure belt](https://www.scstech.com.cn/products/manure-belts/rubber/): Black rubber manure belt supplied as a closed loop, commonly used on lateral and inclined sections of poultry manure systems. Quoted to your section and size.
- [Lateral manure belt](https://www.scstech.com.cn/products/manure-belts/lateral/): Lateral manure belts collect manure from every tier at the row end and pass it to the inclined belt. Specified to your house drawing and end-of-row dimensions.
- [Inclined manure belt](https://www.scstech.com.cn/products/manure-belts/inclined/): Inclined manure belts carry manure out of the poultry house to a truck or manure line. Angle, width and sidewalls are set by your site — send height and run.
- [Egg collection belts](https://www.scstech.com.cn/products/egg-belts/): Polypropylene egg collection belts for automatic egg collection in layer cages. Width matched to your cage’s egg channel. Send cage model and lengths.
- [Ultrasonic belt welder](https://www.scstech.com.cn/products/ultrasonic-welder/): SCS ultrasonic welder for making joints in polypropylene manure belts. Why ultrasonic suits PP, what to check in a joint, and how to request a quote.
- [Manure belt accessories](https://www.scstech.com.cn/products/accessories/): The parts around a stacked-cage manure belt: drive and pinch rollers, idler, tensioning screws, scrapers and tracking devices. Ask what fits your system.
- [Belts for stacked layer cages](https://www.scstech.com.cn/solutions/layer-cages/): How to specify a complete manure belt system for 4–12 tier stacked layer cages: longitudinal, lateral and inclined belts, plus egg belts. Configuration guide.
- [Belts for broiler and breeder cages](https://www.scstech.com.cn/solutions/broiler-breeder/): Manure belts for broiler and breeder cage systems, made to the cage drawing. Send cage model, tiers and row length for a specification.
- [How many metres of manure belt do I need?](https://www.scstech.com.cn/solutions/belt-calculator/): Estimate manure belt quantity for a poultry house: width × (2 × row length + allowance) × tiers × rows. Free calculator, then send it for a checked quote.
- [Quality starts with the specification](https://www.scstech.com.cn/quality/): How SCS specifies, produces and checks manure belts and egg belts: fit to the cage drawing, material matched to position, joints matched to material.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.scstech.com.cn/faq/): Answers on manure belt materials, thickness, width, welding, installation, tracking, egg belts, quoting, delivery and after-sales — from SCS Tianjin.
- [About SCS](https://www.scstech.com.cn/about/): SCS Technology (Tianjin) Co., Ltd. supplies manure belts and egg belts and makes ultrasonic belt welders for poultry cages. Founded 2022, based in Tianjin.
- [Get a quote](https://www.scstech.com.cn/contact/): Request a quotation for manure belts, egg belts or an ultrasonic welder. Send your cage model, tiers and row length. Email, phone and WeChat inside.

- [产品中心](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/products/): 星华兴（SCS）全部产品：PP、PVC、橡胶清粪带，横向、斜向清粪带，集蛋带，超声波焊机和配件，按安装位置对号入座。
- [禽类笼养清粪带](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/products/manure-belts/): 层叠鸡笼清粪带：白色 PP 笼内带，绿色 PVC、黑色橡胶闭环带，横向、斜向清粪带，按笼子尺寸做。
- [PP 清粪带](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/products/manure-belts/pp/): 白色 PP 清粪带，用于层叠鸡笼笼内每层。宽度按笼子定，超声波焊或热熔焊接头。发笼厂图纸询价。
- [PVC 清粪带](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/products/manure-belts/pvc/): 绿色 PVC 清粪带，闭环交付，用于禽舍清粪。PVC 料适合高频焊。询价请说明用在哪一段、带宽、周长和冬季最低气温。
- [橡胶清粪带](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/products/manure-belts/rubber/): 黑色橡胶清粪带，闭环交付，多用在禽舍清粪系统笼外横向、斜向段，按段位和尺寸报价。
- [横向清粪带](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/products/manure-belts/lateral/): 横向清粪带装在笼组尾端，接住各层纵向带落下的粪，交给斜向带出舍。按鸡舍图纸和尾端尺寸定规格。
- [斜向清粪带](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/products/manure-belts/inclined/): 斜向清粪带把粪送出鸡舍，交给运粪车或场区清粪线。角度、宽度、挡边按现场定，请发高度差和水平长度。
- [集蛋带](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/products/egg-belts/): 聚丙烯集蛋带，用于蛋鸡笼自动集蛋，宽度按笼子蛋槽配。询价请发笼型、蛋槽宽度和长度。
- [清粪带超声波焊机](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/products/ultrasonic-welder/): 星华兴（SCS）超声波焊机，用于 PP 清粪带接头。为什么 PP 用超声波焊、接头怎么验，以及询价方式。
- [清粪带配件](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/products/accessories/): 层叠笼清粪带周边配件：驱动辊、压带辊、从动辊、张紧丝杠、刮粪条、跑偏器。按您的系统询配。
- [层叠蛋鸡笼配带方案](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/solutions/layer-cages/): 4–12 层层叠蛋鸡笼整套清粪带怎么配：纵向、横向、斜向三段，加集蛋带。配置说明。
- [肉鸡笼、种鸡笼配带](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/solutions/broiler-breeder/): 肉鸡笼、种鸡笼清粪带，按笼厂图纸做。发笼型、层数、列长，我们出规格。
- [清粪带要多少米？](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/solutions/belt-calculator/): 清粪带用量 ≈ 带宽 ×（列长 × 2 ＋ 余量）× 层数 × 列数。在线估算，再发给我们核对报价。
- [质量从规格开始](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/quality/): 星华兴（SCS）怎么配规格、生产和检查清粪带、集蛋带：尺寸对图纸，材质对位置，接头对材质。
- [常见问题](https://www.scstech.com.cn/zh/faq/): 清粪带材质、厚度、宽度、焊接、安装、跑偏、集蛋带、报价、交期、售后的常见问题解答。
